question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **complete left-front brake replacement** on your Voltrieve Fjord AWD, the service guide calls for the following. The front pads are supplied as an axle set, so that set covers both sides. **Left and right are viewed from the driver’s seat.** Sources: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*; part numbers and fitments from *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*.

| Qty. | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| 1 set | Front brake pads | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front-axle caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | Brake fluid DOT 4 LV | **VP-15168** |

The service guide specifies the 370 mm front disc for the Fjord AWD and says brake fluid is needed for bleeding the circuit afterward. *voltrieve-service-guide.md* The catalog lists the fluid as a 1-litre bottle. *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*

question: brakes-atlas
answer:
For a **complete front-right brake replacement** on the Voltrieve Atlas, order:

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | 400 mm front-right brake disc | **VP-10176** |
| 1 | Front-axle brake pad set (covers both sides) | **VP-10267** |
| 1 | Six-piston fixed front-right brake caliper | **VP-10449** |
| 1 | Front-right brake hose | **VP-10657** |
| 1 | Front-right pad wear sensor | **VP-10683** |
| 1 | Front-axle caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-right brake dust shield | **VP-10839** |
| 1 | Bottle of DOT 4 LV brake fluid | **VP-15168** |

The service guide specifies these items for the job and notes that the Atlas uses a fixed caliper, so **no caliper carrier is needed**. The pad set covers both sides of the front axle. Sources: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*; *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*.

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a **complete front-left brake replacement**, the Lumen service guide calls for a disc, a front-axle pad set, caliper, carrier, hose, fitting kit, dust shield and brake fluid. The pad set covers both front sides, even though you’re working on one side. **Lumen front brake parts differ by drive**-300 mm for RWD and 320 mm for AWD-so confirm your drive before ordering. *(Source: **voltrieve-service-guide.md**.)*

**Parts needed for either drive:**

| Part | Article number |
|---|---|
| Brake hose, front left | **VP-10618** |
| Caliper fitting kit, front axle | **VP-10696** |
| Brake dust shield, front left | **VP-10735** |
| Brake fluid DOT 4 LV | **VP-15168** |

**Then choose the matching drive-specific parts:**

| Part | RWD (300 mm) | AWD (320 mm) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Brake disc, front left | **VP-10020** | **VP-10033** |
| Brake pad set, front axle | **VP-10202** | **VP-10215** |
| Brake caliper, front left | **VP-10293** | **VP-10306** |
| Caliper carrier, front left | **VP-10475** | **VP-10488** |

*(Article numbers and fitments: **voltrieve-parts-brakes.md**.)* The guide says the Lumen has **no electrical pad wear sensor**. *(Source: **voltrieve-service-guide.md**.)*

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a complete **front-left** brake replacement, buy **one item from each drive-specific option below**. The Lumen’s front brake parts differ between RWD and AWD. “Left” is viewed from the driver’s seat. **[voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]**

| Part | Lumen RWD | Lumen AWD |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | **VP-10020** - 300 mm | **VP-10033** - 320 mm |
| Front pad set - covers both front wheels | **VP-10202** - for 300 mm discs | **VP-10215** - for 320 mm discs |
| Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10293** - for 300 mm disc | **VP-10306** - for 320 mm disc |
| Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10475** | **VP-10488** |

**Same for either drive:**
- **VP-10618** - front-left brake hose
- **VP-10696** - front caliper fitting kit
- **VP-10735** - front-left brake dust shield
- **VP-15168** - DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1-litre bottle

The service guide says the job includes the disc, axle-set pads, caliper, carrier, hose, fitting kit, dust shield and brake fluid for bleeding. It also says the Lumen has **no electrical pad-wear sensor**. **[voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]**

Check whether your Lumen is **RWD or AWD** before ordering the drive-specific parts. **[voltrieve-service-guide.md]**
